tool_schemas.name: get_workspaces
tool_schemas.description: List workspaces available to the authenticated Clockify connection and return a single page of workspace records filtered by optional status; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if connection_id/status/limit/cursor are invalid, UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is missing/expired, FORBIDDEN if the connection is not permitted to enumerate workspaces, and RATE_LIMITED when the per-connection/workspace quota is exceeded. Raises NOT_FOUND if the connection_id does not exist in this integration server.

connection_id.description: Clockify connection ULID to list workspaces for.

limit.description: Maximum number of workspaces to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_workspace
tool_schemas.description: Fetch and return a single workspace record by workspace_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the workspace_id is unknown or not accessible to the authenticated context, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks a valid connection or permission to view the workspace. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas for the underlying connection are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: get_user
tool_schemas.description: Return information about the authenticated user for the given connection_id, optionally including membership context scoped to workspace_id when provided. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if connection_id/workspace_id are malformed, NOT_FOUND if the connection_id does not exist or the workspace_id does not exist/is not visible to that connection, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the connection is invalid or not allowed to read user/membership details. Raises RATE_LIMITED when per-connection or per-workspace limits are exceeded.

connection_id.description: Clockify connection ULID identifying the authenticated user context.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to scope the user lookup/membership context.

tool_schemas.name: get_users
tool_schemas.description: List users in the specified workspace and return a single page of user records filtered by optional status; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/status/limit/cursor are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or is not accessible, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to enumerate users for the workspace. Raises RATE_LIMITED when workspace/connection quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to list users for.

limit.description: Maximum number of users to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get_clients
tool_schemas.description: List clients in the specified workspace and return a single page of client records, optionally filtered by archived and/or local status; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/limit/cursor are invalid or if filters are incompatible, NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or is not accessible, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to list clients. Raises RATE_LIMITED when workspace/connection quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to list clients for.

archived.description: If provided, filter clients by archived flag.

limit.description: Maximum number of clients to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create_client
tool_schemas.description: Create a new client in the specified workspace and return the created client record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id is malformed or name is empty/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or is not accessible, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create clients in that workspace. Raises CONFLICT if a client with the same name already exists in the workspace (as enforced by the provider or integration), and RATE_LIMITED when workspace/connection quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to create the client in.

tool_schemas.name: get_projects
tool_schemas.description: List projects in the specified workspace and return a single page of project records filtered by optional client_id, archived, billable, and/or local status; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/client_id/limit/cursor are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or is not accessible (or if a provided client_id is unknown in that workspace), and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot list projects. Raises RATE_LIMITED when workspace/connection quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to list projects for.

client_id.description: Filter projects by associated client entity ULID.

archived.description: If provided, filter projects by archived flag.

billable.description: If provided, filter projects by billable flag.

limit.description: Maximum number of projects to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create_project
tool_schemas.description: Create a new project in the specified workspace and return the created project record, optionally associating it to client_id and setting billable/color/archived. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/client_id are malformed or name is empty/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist or is not accessible (or if client_id does not exist in the workspace), and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create projects. Raises CONFLICT if the provider/integration rejects the create due to an existing project with the same name under the same scope, and RATE_LIMITED when workspace/connection quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID to create the project in.

client_id.description: Optional client entity ULID to associate to the project.

tool_schemas.name: get_tasks
tool_schemas.description: List tasks for the given project in a workspace and return a single page of task records filtered by optional archived/status and ordered by sort; results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor for the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/project_id/limit/cursor/sort are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the workspace or project does not exist or is not accessible within the workspace, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot list tasks for the project. Raises RATE_LIMITED when workspace/connection quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (clk_wsp_...) to scope the lookup.

project_id.description: Project entity ULID (clk_ent_...) to list tasks for.

archived.description: If provided, filter tasks by archived state.

status.description: If provided, filter by local entity status.

limit.description: Maximum number of tasks to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create_task
tool_schemas.description: Create a new task under the specified project in a workspace and return the created task record, optionally setting billable/archived/color. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if workspace_id/project_id are malformed or name is empty/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the workspace or project does not exist or is not accessible, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot create tasks for the project. Raises CONFLICT if a task with the same name already exists for the project (as enforced by the provider or integration), and RATE_LIMITED when workspace/connection quotas are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (clk_wsp_...) where the task will be created.

project_id.description: Project entity ULID (clk_ent_...) to attach the task to.

archived.description: Whether the task should be created archived.

color.description: Optional color value for the task (as supported by the provider).

tool_schemas.name: get_time_entries
tool_schemas.description: Lists time entries for the specified user in a workspace and returns a paged result set ordered by the requested sort, using limit and an opaque cursor for pagination. Applies optional filters (time window, project/task/client/tag, billable, status, and description substring) and returns only entries visible to the authenticated connection for that workspace. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs, unsupported enums, malformed timestamps, or time_from >= time_to; UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is missing/invalid; FORBIDDEN if the connection cannot access the workspace/user; NOT_FOUND if the workspace or user does not exist; RATE_LIMITED when the workspace/user connection quota is exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (clk_wsp_...) to query time entries in.

user_id.description: User entity ULID (clk_ent_...) whose time entries to fetch.

time_from.description: Start of time range (inclusive) to filter by entry start/end.

time_to.description: End of time range (exclusive) to filter by entry start/end.

project_id.description: If provided, filter by project entity ULID (clk_ent_...).

task_id.description: If provided, filter by task entity ULID (clk_ent_...).

client_id.description: If provided, filter by client entity ULID (clk_ent_...).

tag_ids.description: If provided, filter to entries containing any of these tag entity ULIDs.

billable.description: If provided, filter by billable flag.

status.description: If provided, filter by time entry status.

description_search.description: If provided, substring search against the description.

limit.description: Maximum number of time entries to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

sort.description: Sort order for returned time entries.

tool_schemas.name: create_time_entry
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new time entry in the given workspace for the given user and returns the created time entry. The entry is created with the provided description/billable flags and optional project/task/client/tags, and with a start_at and optional end_at (omitting end_at creates a running entry only if supported by the provider model for this endpoint). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs, malformed timestamps, end_at <= start_at, or incompatible associations (e.g., task_id without a matching project_id when required); UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is missing/invalid; FORBIDDEN if the connection cannot create entries in the workspace or for the user; NOT_FOUND if the workspace/user or any referenced entity (project/task/client/tag) does not exist in that workspace; CONFLICT if the requested state transition is not allowed (e.g., creating an overlapping/duplicate running entry for a user that already has one); RATE_LIMITED when the workspace/user connection quota is exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (clk_wsp_...) where the time entry will be created.

user_id.description: User entity ULID (clk_ent_...) who owns the time entry.

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable.

project_id.description: Optional project entity ULID (clk_ent_...) to associate.

task_id.description: Optional task entity ULID (clk_ent_...) to associate.

client_id.description: Optional client entity ULID (clk_ent_...) to associate.

tag_ids.description: Optional list of tag entity ULIDs (clk_ent_...) to associate.

start_at.description: Start timestamp for the time entry.

end_at.description: End timestamp for the time entry.

tool_schemas.name: start_timer
tool_schemas.description: Starts a running timer by creating a running time entry for the specified user in the workspace and returns the running entry. If start_at is omitted we use the current time; optional project/task/client/tags and billable/description are applied to the running entry. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs or timestamps, or incompatible associations; UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is missing/invalid; FORBIDDEN if the connection cannot start timers in the workspace or for the user; NOT_FOUND if the workspace/user or any referenced entity does not exist; CONFLICT if the user already has an active running timer; RATE_LIMITED when the workspace/user connection quota is exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (clk_wsp_...) where the timer will run.

user_id.description: User entity ULID (clk_ent_...) starting the timer.

description.description: Timer description for the running entry.

billable.description: Whether the running entry is billable.

project_id.description: Optional project entity ULID (clk_ent_...) to associate.

task_id.description: Optional task entity ULID (clk_ent_...) to associate.

client_id.description: Optional client entity ULID (clk_ent_...) to associate.

tag_ids.description: Optional list of tag entity ULIDs (clk_ent_...) to associate.

start_at.description: Optional start timestamp; defaults to now if omitted.

tool_schemas.name: stop_timer
tool_schemas.description: Stops the user’s current running timer in the specified workspace and returns the updated (stopped) time entry. If end_at is omitted we use the current time and set the running entry’s end timestamp accordingly. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid ULIDs or malformed end_at, or end_at earlier than the entry start; UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is missing/invalid; FORBIDDEN if the connection cannot stop timers in the workspace or for the user; NOT_FOUND if the workspace/user does not exist or there is no running timer to stop; CONFLICT if the timer is not in a stoppable state; RATE_LIMITED when the workspace/user connection quota is exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (clk_wsp_...) where the running timer exists.

user_id.description: User entity ULID (clk_ent_...) whose current running timer should be stopped.

end_at.description: Optional end timestamp; defaults to now if omitted.

tool_schemas.name: get_tags
tool_schemas.description: Lists tags in a workspace and returns a paged result set ordered by the requested sort, using limit and an opaque cursor for pagination. You can filter by archived flag and/or local entity status to include active/archived/deleted tags as supported by the integration’s local model. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid workspace_id, unsupported enums, or invalid paging parameters; UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is missing/invalid; FORBIDDEN if the connection cannot access the workspace; NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist; RATE_LIMITED when the workspace/user connection quota is exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (clk_wsp_...) to list tags for.

archived.description: If provided, filter tags by archived state.

status.description: If provided, filter by local entity status.

limit.description: Maximum number of tags to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create_tag
tool_schemas.description: Creates a tag in the specified workspace and returns the created tag, including its provider-compatible color (if supplied) and initial archived state. The tag name must be non-empty and is created within the workspace scope of the authenticated connection. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid workspace_id, empty name, or invalid color format as accepted by the provider; UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is missing/invalid; FORBIDDEN if the connection cannot create tags in the workspace; NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist; CONFLICT if a tag with the same name already exists in the workspace (when the provider enforces uniqueness); RATE_LIMITED when the workspace/user connection quota is exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID (clk_wsp_...) where the tag will be created.

color.description: Optional color value for the tag (as supported by the provider).

archived.description: Whether the tag should be created archived.

tool_schemas.name: detailed_report
tool_schemas.description: Generates (or retrieves a previously generated) detailed time report for a workspace over the given [time_from, time_to) window and returns the persisted report payload plus metadata for consistent re-serving. The request’s filters object is stored with the report request and applied to the underlying time-entry query used to build the detailed rows. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed timestamps, time_from >= time_to, or invalid filter structure; UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is missing/invalid; FORBIDDEN if the connection cannot access reports/time data for the workspace; NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist; RATE_LIMITED when report generation or retrieval exceeds the per workspace/user connection quota; CONFLICT if report generation is refused due to an unsupported state (e.g., workspace connection not ready).

workspace_id.description: Internal workspace ULID to generate the report for.

time_from.description: Start of reporting window (inclusive) in ISO-8601.

time_to.description: End of reporting window (exclusive) in ISO-8601.

filters.description: Optional report filters persisted with the report request.

tool_schemas.name: summary_report
tool_schemas.description: Generates (or retrieves a previously generated) summary time report for a workspace over the given [time_from, time_to) window and returns the persisted report payload plus metadata for consistent re-serving. The request’s filters object is stored with the report request and applied to the aggregation used to build summary group totals. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed timestamps, time_from >= time_to, or invalid filter structure; UNAUTHORIZED if the connection is missing/invalid; FORBIDDEN if the connection cannot access reports/time data for the workspace; NOT_FOUND if the workspace does not exist; RATE_LIMITED when report generation or retrieval exceeds the per workspace/user connection quota; CONFLICT if report generation is refused due to an unsupported state (e.g., workspace connection not ready).

workspace_id.description: Internal workspace ULID to generate the report for.

time_from.description: Start of reporting window (inclusive) in ISO-8601.

time_to.description: End of reporting window (exclusive) in ISO-8601.

filters.description: Optional report filters persisted with the report request.

tool_schemas.name: test_clockify_connection
tool_schemas.description: Test connection to Clockify API and get user information

connection_id.description: Internal Clockify connection ULID to test.

tool_schemas.name: get_connection
tool_schemas.description: Fetch and return a single Clockify connection record by connection_id. Returns the persisted connection metadata (never the raw API key), including status and last success/error details. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if connection_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the connection_id does not exist, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller is not permitted to view the connection. Raises RATE_LIMITED when connection-level quotas apply.

tool_schemas.name: update_connection
tool_schemas.description: Update a Clockify connection and return the updated connection record. Supports lifecycle transitions via status to revoke the connection or clear an error back to active; may also update the default_workspace_id. Refuses illegal status transitions and refuses updates to immutable identity fields. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if inputs are invalid, NOT_FOUND if connection_id is unknown, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot modify the connection, and CONFLICT if the requested change violates server rules.

status.description: New connection status; allowed transitions: active->(error|revoked), error->(active|revoked).

default_workspace_id.description: Set the default workspace ULID used when a workspace is not explicitly selected.

tool_schemas.name: get_project
tool_schemas.description: Fetch and return a single project record by project_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the project is unknown or not accessible in the specified workspace, and UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN when the caller lacks a valid connection or permission to view the project. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas for the underlying connection are exceeded.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID that the project belongs to.

project_id.description: Workspace entity ULID of type 'project' to fetch.

tool_schemas.name: update_project
tool_schemas.description: Update a project in the specified workspace and return the updated project record. Supports name/client/billable/color changes and lifecycle transitions via status (archive/unarchive or soft-delete). Refuses illegal transitions and refuses to hard-delete projects referenced by existing time entries (soft-deletes by marking status='deleted'). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed ids or invalid fields, NOT_FOUND if the project/workspace is unknown or not accessible, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot modify projects, and CONFLICT when referential integrity rules would be violated.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID that the project belongs to.

project_id.description: Workspace entity ULID of type 'project' to update.

client_id.description: Workspace entity ULID of type 'client' to associate to the project; set to null to clear.

billable.description: Whether time tracked on the project is billable by default.

color.description: Project color as a hex RGB string.

status.description: New local project status; allowed transitions: active->(archived|deleted), archived->(active|deleted).

tool_schemas.name: update_time_entry
tool_schemas.description: Update a time entry and return the updated time entry record. Allows editing description, project/task/client/billable/tags and time bounds for stopped entries, and supports lifecycle transition to deleted. Refuses setting a task without a project, refuses tasks that do not belong to the project, and rejects invalid tag ids (must be 'tag' entities in the same workspace). If the entry is running, end_at cannot be set via this endpoint (use stop_timer). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid fields, NOT_FOUND if the entry is unknown, UNAUTHORIZED/FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot modify the entry, and CONFLICT when business rules are violated.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ULID that the time entry belongs to.

project_entity_id.description: Workspace entity ULID of type 'project' to set on the entry; set to null to clear.

task_entity_id.description: Workspace entity ULID of type 'task' to set; requires project_entity_id and must belong to that project; set to null to clear.

client_entity_id.description: Workspace entity ULID of type 'client' to set; set to null to clear.

billable.description: Whether the time entry is billable.

tag_entity_ids.description: List of workspace entity ULIDs of type 'tag' to apply to the entry.

start_at.description: New start timestamp (ISO-8601). Only allowed when entry is stopped.

end_at.description: New end timestamp (ISO-8601). Only allowed when entry is stopped and must be after start_at.

status.description: New local time entry status; only transition supported by this endpoint is running|stopped -> deleted.

tool_schemas.name: whoami
tool_schemas.description: Return the calling identity and current entitlements for this integration server, including the active Clockify connection (if any), the effective scopes/permissions, and current rate-limit/quota consumption for that connection. Refuses requests with invalid authentication context and returns UNAUTHORIZED when no valid caller identity is present.

connection_id.description: Optional connection ULID to scope quota/rate-limit reporting; when omitted, uses the active connection if present.

metadata.name: Clockify Time Tracking Integration Server
metadata.description: This backend powers an integration server that proxies Clockify time-tracking operations for an authenticated user: listing/creating workspace entities (clients, projects, tasks, tags) and managing time entries including a running timer. It also persists generated reports and integration audit logs
